title: Recording and materials — 2026 Candidate Briefing (City Council Special Meeting, 2026-08-20)
summary:
Asks the City Clerk for the complete record of the City Council Special Meeting held 2026-08-20 at 6:00 PM in the Council Chamber, agendized as "Candidate Briefing for the November 2026 Election" (PrimeGov meeting ID 2372):

- Item 1: all audio and video recordings made by or at the direction of the City — the Channel San Mateo broadcast recording, any recording made for posting to the City's YouTube channel or Public Meeting Portal, and any Zoom cloud recording of webinar ID 899 4193 7699,
- Item 2: caption, transcript, or CART files in native format,
- Items 3-4: presentations, slide decks, handouts, and the candidate briefing packet, including department-specific materials,
- Item 5: records identifying City staff who presented, by name and title, plus any run-of-show or internal agenda,
- Item 6: the agenda as originally posted and as amended, with posting timestamps and what the amendment changed,
- Item 7: minutes or the Clerk's notes,
- Item 8: City Clerk communications with department heads about the briefing's content or scope, 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-21.

The request cites Gov. Code § 54953.5(b) and asks for confirmation that the item 1 recordings have been preserved.

policy_promises.quote: Any tape or film record of an open and public meeting made for whatever purpose by or at the direction of the local agency shall be subject to inspection pursuant to the California Public Records Act ... but ... may be erased or destroyed 30 days after the taping or recording.
policy_promises.tests: Does a City recording of the 2026-08-20 open meeting exist, and is it produced before the 30-day erasure window closes on or about 2026-09-19?

policy_promises.quote: agency must notify requester within 10 calendar days whether it will produce records
policy_promises.tests: Does the City issue a determination by 2026-08-31?

prior_pra_refs.note: The produced § 463.10 search-audit corpus against which the Department's public statements about ALPR misuse can be checked.

filed_because: The 2026-08-20 candidate briefing was a noticed City Council special meeting at which the Police Department addressed the ALPR program. Any City-made recording of an open meeting is a public record under Gov. Code § 54953.5(b) but may be erased 30 days after taping, and as of 2026-08-21 no video had been posted to the City's YouTube channel or Public Meeting Portal (PrimeGov meeting 2372 shows no video URL and no completed stream). The request secures the meeting record, the presentation materials, and the posting history of the amended agenda before the erasure window opens.
notes:
Filed 2026-08-21; auto-acknowledged the same day at 8:57 AM and forwarded to department(s) for processing. Statutory determination due 2026-08-31. § 54953.5(b) erasure window opens on or about 2026-09-19.

Addressed to the City Clerk rather than the Police Department — this is a Council meeting record.

Agenda observation supporting item 6: both agenda documents for this special meeting were published at 4:20 PM on 2026-08-20, about 1 hour 40 minutes before the 6:00 PM start, under an "AMENDED AGENDA" header.
